Executive Summary The CUI is one of the leading graduate research institutions in Pakistan. CUI is committed to providing a breadth of study and excellent interdisciplinary experience classified in different faculties under twenty-two distinct departments at CUI campuses. In addition to our outstanding faculty, exceptional facilities, state-of-the-art research and library resources, the campuses have a warm and collegial spirit that is conducive to personal growth and scholarship. Our mission is to serve as a center for research, scholarship and creativity and to teach a diverse community of undergraduate, graduate, and professional students to become the next generation of leaders in academia, industry, and public services.
